WITH joined AS (
  SELECT ab.translink, t.tradekind
  FROM advancedbehavior ab
  JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg
  JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
),
grouped AS (
  SELECT translink, tradekind, COUNT(*) as group_count
  FROM joined
  GROUP BY translink, tradekind
),
trader_sums AS (
  SELECT tradekind, SUM(group_count) as total_count
  FROM grouped
  GROUP BY tradekind
),
with_ratios AS (
  SELECT g.translink, g.tradekind, g.group_count,
    CAST(g.group_count AS FLOAT) / CAST(ts.total_count AS FLOAT) as ratio
  FROM grouped g
  JOIN trader_sums ts ON g.tradekind = ts.tradekind
),
trader_avg_ratios AS (
  SELECT tradekind, AVG(ratio) as avg_ratio
  FROM with_ratios
  GROUP BY tradekind
),
kept AS (
  SELECT wr.tradekind, wr.group_count, wr.ratio, 
    wr.ratio - tar.avg_ratio as difference
  FROM with_ratios wr
  JOIN trader_avg_ratios tar ON wr.tradekind = tar.tradekind
  WHERE wr.ratio > tar.avg_ratio
),
final_agg AS (
  SELECT tradekind, AVG(group_count) as avg_group_count,
    AVG(ratio) as avg_ratio_value, AVG(difference) as avg_difference
  FROM kept
  GROUP BY tradekind
)
SELECT tradekind, avg_group_count, avg_ratio_value, avg_difference
FROM final_agg
ORDER BY tradekind
